visual_requirements.description: Sita as the human incarnation of Lakshmi: one adult woman, one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs. Fully opaque ceremonial sari and jewellery are respectful editorial dress, not a sourced specific costume.

A visibly physical wall and rolling foreground tongues of fire depict the Agni Pariksha ordeal in the versions documented in c08. Fire is the surrounding ordeal, not a weapon or fire-control power attributed to Sita.
The fire ordeal itself supplies the immediate setting; no forest, landscape, invented temple or unrelated return-to-earth episode.

prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of SITA, the Hindu goddess and human incarnation of Lakshmi, undergoing the Agni Pariksha fire ordeal in the Ramayana version that includes it. Respectful sacred devotional grandeur. [sita-c01, sita-c03, sita-c14, sita-c08]
ANATOMY: ONE adult South Asian woman with exactly one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs. Fully opaque deep crimson sari and high-neck gold blouse, richly woven gold fabric borders, gold jewellery, no exposed torso, no extra limbs. Jewellery reflects the jewellery in her story; exact costume design is artistic interpretation. [sita-c14, sita-c16]
MOMENT: Sita strides through the surrounding fire directly toward the viewer, fierce spiritual resolve and unwavering compassionate gaze slightly down toward us; one hand lifted outward at chest level in an open composed gesture and the other holding a sweeping fold of sari at her side. Her brow is resolute, never blank or distressed. The sweeping heavy drapery and one forward step make a forceful moving silhouette.
POWER: The physical Agni Pariksha fire surrounds her on both sides and behind her, turbulent tongues of orange flame curl across the immediate foreground at her feet, sparks rise into smoke. This is the documented ordeal, NOT Sita emitting fire, attacking, or controlling flame; no fire from her eyes or hands. [sita-c08]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low-angle close heroic framing, her face and clothed torso huge in the square image, her figure occupying approximately eighty-five percent of image height and most of its width. Camera is very near her forward foot looking upward. Natural human anatomy and proportions; grandeur comes from framing, the ordeal and silhouette, no literal giant body. The fire is near and palpable rather than a distant landscape. Face and sacred resolve remain instantly legible at thumbnail size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: the surrounding real orange fire is the single dominant lighting source, sharp firelit rim along her cloth, dark smoke background, dramatic deep shadows, warm face modelling, airborne ember specks physically from flames. No glowing halo, magic rays or generic aura.
SURFACE: tactile crimson woven silk, burnished gold jewellery, heavy embroidered hems, realistic warm skin, turbulent painterly flame and sooty smoke.
SETTING: within the Agni Pariksha ordeal, entirely focused on her and the near fire; no scenic vista, buildings, throne or bystanders. [sita-c08]
MOOD: awe-inspiring divine courage and dignity, overwhelming sacred presence, energetic and imposing. A reverent Hindu devotional illustration, never a monster, victim in distress, ordinary casual passerby or decorative fashion portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, invented weapon or crown; no earth-return scene, no Maya Sita duplicate, no burns or wounds. ONE square image.
